user.title: HAFAS Bus Monitor
user.description: Create the integration hub. Stops/tiles are added afterwards with the Add button on the integration page. Polling runs every 30 seconds between 06:00 and 22:00.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HAFAS Bus Monitor entry is allowed. Add stops to the existing entry.

init.title: HAFAS Bus Monitor settings
init.description: Polling runs only between 06:00 and 22:00. An optional holiday sensor pauses polling while it is on.

user.title: Select city
user.description: Enter the city for the stop search.

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} stops found for "{query}". Select the correct one.

lines.title: Select buses
lines.description: Enter the preferred lines for {stop} as a comma-separated list. Leave empty for all lines.

targets.title: Select destinations
targets.description: Line {line} at {stop}. Select one or more destinations; leave everything unselected for all destinations.

error.cannot_connect: The HAFAS/NAH.SH service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_stops: No stop was found for this search. Try a shorter or slightly different search term.
error.invalid_stop: The selected stop is invalid. Please try again.
error.stop_required: A stop search term is required.

refresh.name: Refresh departures
refresh.description: Fetch fresh HAFAS departure data for all configured stops immediately.
